name: Lil Fullard
source:
A half-human, half-beast girl, who is also a summoning magician, was born with an extraordinary amount of magical power. Her talent is high even among magicians. Orphaned at a young age due to certain circumstances, her magical talent was recognized, and she was raised as an adopted child of the Fullard family. The Fullard family is one of the most prestigious families in the Mephi Principality, with a history comparable to that of the Loki family. Due to her natural magical talent and the Principality's educational policy that emphasizes efficiency, she is known as the best magician in the Principality. 

In order to repay the kindness of the Fullard family, she is very competitive with Amber, who is close to her age, and tries not to lose to the Loki family. However, Amber prioritizes her own training over competing with others, so her enthusiasm is not conveyed well. She is accompanied by Yuuiki, a high-ranking spirit of light and darkness, for some reason. Both of her subordinates act and think beyond her imagination, which often makes her feel flustered and unable to keep her cool.
